Short description: JPN > US > FRE

Long description: Despite it's lower bitrate, US disc has better PQ than FRE, both being Extended. Most screens clearly show more detail in US. But JPN disc trumps both when it comes to PQ. It has better grain retention and a bit more detail than US. Sadly, it's only Theatrical Cut. Although I do like the AR on JPN, I hate that it's different from the other two because it makes a hybrid impossible. And I don't understand why JPN has different colors in the last 2 screens... some scenes were mastered differently
So it comes down to what you want more... for best PQ, you go for JPN if you can live with the fact that it's not Extended. If you really want the Extended Cut, US is your best pick.

I haven't included TWN disc because not only is it Theatrical Cut, but I already made a comparison with 2 screens versus the ones in the torrent description and it has a lot less detail than US or JPN, plus it has a very annoying teal tint.

              US (25256 kbps @ 23.976 fps)             vs.                FRE (31141 kbps @ 24 fps)                vs.             JPN (35168 kbps @ 23.976 fps)
